description:
AWS Security's Security Communications (SecComms) team builds and operates the platforms, tools, and systems that enable Amazon's security organization to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at scale. We support security events, ongoing security programs, vulnerability communications, and strategic initiatives that span multiple Amazon business units and AWS services. Our engineering products are the connective tissue between security findings, remediation owners, and the people responsible for keeping
Amazon and its customers safe.

We are seeking a senior Software Development Engineer to lead the design, development, and operation of software systems that power security communications workflows, automation, and integrations at scale. This role is for a technical leader who brings engineering rigor to ambiguous problems where the business need is understood but the technology strategy is not yet defined, who owns outcomes across system boundaries, and who thrives working across organizational boundaries with security engineers, program managers, and communications professionals. You will own the architectural direction of the SecComms platform, lead projects staffed by multiple engineers, and act as a force multiplier for the team.

Security Communications serves as the engineering and operations hub for AWS-related security messaging, stakeholder notification, and communications tooling across the organization. Our team is responsible for building scalable platforms that enable consistent, reliable, and timely communication during high-severity security events, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and routine security program operations. We are a cross-functional team - engineers work shoulder-to-shoulder with communications professionals, security operations personnel, AWS service owners, and executives. Candidates should be comfortable leading discussions and building consensus in this environment across both technical and non-technical domains.

Key job responsibilities
Design & Delivery
• Own the architecture and technical direction of major systems within the SecComms platform, leading delivery across the full lifecycle - product strategy, scoping, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
• Work backwards from customer and stakeholder needs to define requirements, then define the technology strategy to meet them where none yet exists, translating ambiguity into well-designed, extensible software.
• Solve complex problems with multiple risks and roadblocks using solutions that are as simple as possible, both directly and by directing the work of other engineers, and explain those problems to others in simple, concise terms.
• Balance constraints across new feature development, technical debt, and operational reliability; identify one-way-door decisions and advocate for the right long-term solution rather than short-term workarounds.
• Produce exemplary, well-tested, documented code that sets the standard others emulate and adheres to the Amazon Code Bar.

Operational Excellence
• Lead ongoing operational support for the team with appropriate alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and on-call response; effectively prioritize trade-offs between operational improvements and other work.
• Drive resolution of the root causes of operational issues and address systemic issues that reduce support costs across the team's services.
• Take the lead in identifying and solving architecture deficiencies and areas where software bottlenecks innovation, including in systems you depend on but do not own.
• Ensure software failures are addressed with permanent fixes that prevent recurring incidents.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Partnership
• Partner with security engineers, program managers, communications leads, and adjacent teams to understand the business and customer value of the team's software, and influence the roadmaps and technical decisions of teams you depend on but don't control.
• Build consensus and make an inclusive space for differing views when integrations, dependencies, or shared priorities arise across organizational boundaries.
• Make effective priority trade-offs between feature development and operational work, prioritizing long-term results - software quality, business requirements, customer experience, and maintainability - across your team's and related teams' products.
• Communicate technical designs and decisions clearly in writing to both technical audiences and to non-technical stakeholders and leadership.

Mentorship & Engineering Culture
• Actively coach or mentor multiple engineers, on your team and beyond; serve as someone members of other teams seek out for expertise.
• Drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team; train new team members on how the SecComms software is constructed, tested, operated, and secured, and how it fits into the broader Amazon Security architecture.
• Own and maintain documentation of what the team's software does, how it is built, and how it connects to the bigger picture; keep it current as systems evolve.
• Seek diverse perspectives and feedback early, and proactively identify and drive adoption of industry innovations including new tools, design patterns, and AWS capabilities to ensure the team's skills keep pace.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
- Experience in one or more of the following domains: access- control system and methodology, network security, application- and system-development security, security architecture and models, cryptography, and operations security

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location.
